description.zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录[DataWorks控制台](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。
description.en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. To obtain the workspace ID, log on to the [DataWorks console](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and navigate to the workspace configuration page.

description.zh:
资源包含的具体的文件流或OSS下载链接。
><notice>该字段允许用户填写文件流或OSS下载链接。当填写OSS下载链接时，请确保该OSS链接可被公开访问。推荐提供预签名URL。></notice>
description.en:
The specific file stream or OSS download link contained in the resource.

> This field allows users to provide a file stream or an OSS download link. When providing an OSS download link, ensure that the OSS link is publicly accessible. A presigned URL is recommended.

description.zh: 描述这个资源文件的FlowSpec信息，具体规范详见[FlowSpec](https://github.com/aliyun/dataworks-spec/blob/master/README_zh_CN.md)。
description.en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. To obtain the workspace ID, log on to the [DataWorks console](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and navigate to the workspace configuration page.

title.zh: 创建数据开发文件资源

descriptions.zh: ><notice>该接口不支持批量操作，若FlowSpec中定义了不止一个资源文件，则除第一个以外的后续资源文件均会被忽略。></notice>
descriptions.en:
><notice>

This API does not support batch operations. If you define more than one resource file in the FlowSpec, all resource files except the first one are ignored.

></notice>
